convert_falcon_checkpoint: convert a Falcon custom code checkpoint directory to a modern Transformers-compatible Falcon checkpoint
validate_checkpoint_directory: validate that a directory contains the required configuration_RW.py and modelling_RW.py files for a custom code checkpoint
update_config_json_fields: update config.json by renaming model class names and mapping legacy transformer config keys to modern equivalents
update_tokenizer_config: update tokenizer_config.json to add model_input_names for PreTrainedTokenizerFast tokenizers
create_generation_config: create a generation_config.json file with bos_token_id, eos_token_id, and transformers_version from the model config
